ground_truth.description: In ERC-4337, validateUserOp uses external self-call to isValidSignature, changing msg.sender to wallet instead of entrypoint. BaseAuth.signatureValidation enforces caller binding, causing revert for static signatures bound to entrypoint.
ground_truth.root_cause: In ERC-4337, validateUserOp uses external self-call to isValidSignature, changing msg.sender to wallet instead of entrypoint. BaseAuth.signatureValidation enforces caller binding, causing revert for static signatures bound to entrypoint.
ground_truth.attack_scenario: Deploy wallet with static signature bound to entrypoint. Attempt validateUserOp → reverts with InvalidStaticSignatureWrongCaller. PoC: Add test to test/modules/ERC4337v07.t.sol: test_validateUserOp_staticSig_callerMismatch_reverts. Uses server and forge test.
ground_truth.fix_description: Avoid external self-call; propagate intended caller into validation.

vulnerabilities.explanation: The contract uses external self-call `this.isValidSignature()` in validateUserOp, which changes msg.sender to the wallet address instead of the entrypoint. BaseAuth.signatureValidation checks static signatures bound to msg.sender, causing revert when static signatures are bound to the entrypoint address.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: 1. Deploy wallet with static signature bound to entrypoint address. 2. EntryPoint calls validateUserOp with userOp. 3. validateUserOp calls this.isValidSignature(userOpHash, signature). 4. BaseAuth.signatureValidation checks static signature binding to msg.sender (now wallet address). 5. Since static signature is bound to entrypoint address, validation fails with InvalidStaticSignatureWrongCaller revert. 6. User operation validation fails, preventing legitimate operations.
vulnerabilities.suggested_fix: Avoid external self-call to isValidSignature. Pass the intended caller (entrypoint) as parameter to signature validation. Change: `if (this.isValidSignature(userOpHash, userOp.signature) != IERC1271_MAGIC_VALUE_HASH)` to internal call with explicit caller parameter.

prediction.overall_explanation: The ERC4337v07 contract has a critical design flaw where validateUserOp uses external self-call to isValidSignature, changing msg.sender context. This breaks static signature validation in BaseAuth when signatures are bound to entrypoint address. The vulnerability causes legitimate user operations to revert, resulting in denial of service. The issue is clearly exploitable without requiring trusted role compromise.
